r = await yuki_workspace_read({"path":"/workspace/start.txt"})

cur = r['data']['text'].strip()

guard = 0
receipts = []
while guard < 500 and cur and cur != 'END':
    guard += 1
    rr = await yuki_workspace_read({"path":"/workspace/" + cur})

        fields[k.strip()] = v.strip()
    val = int(fields['value'])

    nxt = fields['left'] if val % 2 == 0 else fields['right']
    cur = nxt

lines = ["%s\t%d" % (p, v) for p, v in visited]
total = sum(v for _, v in visited)

import asyncio

def parse_node(txt):
    d = {}
    for line in txt.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or "=" not in line:
            continue
        k, v = line.split("=", 1)
        d[k.strip()] = v.strip()
    return d

visited = [["nodes/34aaa432.txt", 79], ["nodes/71403a74.txt", 66]]
log = []

# validate start pointer and node0
rs = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "start.txt"})
st = rs["data"]["text"].strip() if rs.get("ok") else "<FAIL>"
log.append("start=" + st)
r0 = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "nodes/34aaa432.txt"})
d0 = parse_node(r0["data"]["text"])
v0 = int(d0["value"])
n0 = d0["left"] if v0 % 2 == 0 else d0["right"]
log.append("n0=" + str(v0) + "->" + n0)

# catch-up audits for already visited nodes (exactly once each)
for i in range(len(visited)):
    p = "audit/%02d.txt" % i
    ex = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": p})
    if ex.get("ok"):
        dd = ex.get("data") or {}
        et = dd.get("text") if hasattr(dd, "get") else None
        want = str(visited[i][1]) + "\n"
        log.append("exists:" + p + ":match=" + str(et == want))
    else:
        w = await yuki_workspace_write({"path": p, "text": str(visited[i][1]) + "\n"})
        log.append("wrote:" + p + "=" + str(w.get("ok")))

# derive next path from last visited node
last = visited[-1]
rl = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": last[0]})
dl = parse_node(rl["data"]["text"])
lv = int(dl["value"])
cur = dl["left"] if lv % 2 == 0 else dl["right"]
log.append("last=" + last[0] + "=" + str(lv) + "->" + cur)

idx = len(visited)
guard = 0
while cur.upper() != "END" and guard < 5000:
    guard += 1
    rr = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": cur})
    if not rr.get("ok"):
        log.append("READFAIL:" + cur)
        break
    d = parse_node(rr["data"]["text"])
    if "value" not in d:
        log.append("NOVALUE:" + cur)
        break
    v = int(d["value"])
    visited.append([cur, v])
    w = await yuki_workspace_write({"path": "audit/%02d.txt" % idx, "text": str(v) + "\n"})
    log.append("v" + str(idx) + ":" + cur + "=" + str(v) + ";ok=" + str(w.get("ok")))
    idx += 1
    cur = d.get("left", "END") if v % 2 == 0 else d.get("right", "END")

total = 0
for pv in visited:
    total += pv[1]
lines = []
for pv in visited:
    lines.append(pv[0] + "\t" + str(pv[1]))
lines.append("TOTAL\t" + str(total))
out = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

params = {"path": "chain.tsv", "text": out}
ex = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "chain.tsv"})
if ex.get("ok"):
    dd = ex.get("data") or {}
    ver = dd.get("version") if hasattr(dd, "get") else None
    if ver is not None:
        params["expected_version"] = ver
w = await yuki_workspace_write(params)
log.append("chain_write=" + str(w.get("ok")))

rb = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "chain.tsv"})
text = rb["data"]["text"] if rb.get("ok") else "<FAIL>"
match = (text == out)

print("===CHAIN_BEGIN===")
print(text)
print("===CHAIN_END===")
print("nodes=" + str(len(visited)) + " total=" + str(total) + " guard=" + str(guard) + " readback_match=" + str(match))
print("LOG: " + " | ".join(log))
